description: This Zenodo release provides anonymised freight transport order records supplied by two German forwarders. The Data in Brief article describes 31,352 disposition records spanning sixteen months: one operator contributed a continuous five-month 2024 window with thirty-seven heavy vehicles, and the other contributed eighty-three vehicles over a longer period. Preserved fields include trip distances, time windows, vehicle or driver identifiers and day sequences; company and personal identifiers were anonymised. Zenodo lists one CSV and an Apache-2.0 licence. This is order-dispatch evidence from two operators, not every executed vehicle path or a nationally representative truck fleet. The authors note that payload mass is missing, which limits energy-use calculations; anonymisation and differing operator windows are further limitations. A reviewer-assessed use is constructing freight trip, routing or electrification scenarios. model-vroom is a related vehicle-routing model, but no order-to-instance conversion was tested. No CSV was downloaded.
